elaine: Heads up, our CI started failing sporadically for the JS SDK tests when run under Vitest w/ ESM. Locally `npm test` passes but CI (GH actions) flakes with import/mocking errors. Anyone seen this pattern?
sam: What error do you get in CI?
elaine: Copying the relevant bit: 
```
Error: Cannot assign to read only property 'default' of object '#<Object>'
 at Object../node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.js (handler.test.ts:8:12)
```
Also some runs show `Cannot find module '@redwood/inference'` from ts-jest transforms.
kevin: Sounds like multiple things: (1) bundler/transform differences between local and GH actions (vite/esbuild vs node resolution), (2) ESM default vs named shape being mutated by mocks.
elaine: We're using "type":"module" in the sample-app to test edge compatibility, and the SDK ships ESM-only build + a tiny cjs interop.
sam: For Vitest try setting deps.inline for the SDK, and set `esbuild: { target: 'es2020' }` maybe. Also `test: { environment: 'edge-runtime', transformMode: { web: [/\.ts$/] } }` helped me when mocking fetch.
kevin: For Jest (older runners) the issue is often `babel-jest`/`ts-jest` interop with ESM packages. If the package exports only an ESM entry, jest will sometimes try to require it and break. You can add a small cjs entry and map it in package.json exports: "{\"./package.json\": \"./package.json\", \".\": { \"import\": \"dist/index.mjs\", \"require\": \"dist/index.cjs\" } }".
elaine: We tried adding `import * as inference from '@redwood/inference'` in tests to avoid default import confusion and it reduced flakes, but it's ugly.
sam: Another robust pattern: in tests use `const sdk = await vi.importActual('@redwood/inference')` then `vi.mock('@redwood/inference', () => ({ ...sdk, createClient: () => ({ predict: () => 'ok' }) }))`. Keeps module shape intact.
kevin: Also add a `test/types.d.ts` with `declare module '@redwood/inference' { export function createClient(...args:any): any }` so TypeScript in the test runner doesn't fail if it can't resolve package .d.ts.
elaine: CI stack trace also had `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` in some flakes (jest tried to `require` the package). We pinned jest to v29 and added `transformIgnorePatterns` to make sure node_modules/@redwood/inference is transpiled by babel when using jest.
sam: For Vitest, `deps: { inline: ['@redwood/inference'] }` plus `resolve: { conditions: ['import', 'worker'] }` in vite config can improve resolution to ESM shapes for edge.
kevin: We should update the SDK publish to: (1) include dual cjs/esm bundles, (2) add an `exports` map, (3) ship `dist/index.d.ts`, and (4) add a `exports` test in CI that installs SDK via registry and runs the sample-app tests under both node and edge envs.
elaine: Created issue + minimal repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/520 (attached GH actions logs and a simple repo).
devex-bot: Tagged issue with `devex/ci-flake` and `sdk/js`
sam: Short-term for the sample app README add a Troubleshooting section with: 
- Prefer named imports in tests if possible
- Vitest config snippet: 
```
export default defineConfig({
  test: {
    environment: 'edge-runtime',
    deps: { inline: ['@redwood/inference'] },
    transformMode: { web: [/\.tsx?$/] }
  },
  resolve: { conditions: ['import'] }
})
```
- Jest note: add `transformIgnorePatterns: ["/node_modules/(?!@redwood/inference)"]` and/or provide a cjs export.
kevin: I'll follow up on the SDK PR to add the cjs shim and typings. For now, replicate the repro on GH actions with matrix runs for node/vitest/jest so we can catch the flake early.
elaine: Thanks, locking this thread 28will update issue when SDK release lands29.
